text: {"name":"mac_rx_dpc_handler","confidence":"high","docstring":"Decodes a pending received 802.11 frame into shared RX metadata, or services a Bluetooth RX request when no Wi-Fi frame is pending.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v1":"context_flags","v2":"context","v4":"rx_info","v5":"handled","v8":"rx_frame","v9":"frame_control","v10":"sequence_control","v11":"ds_direction_bits","v12":"frame_type_subtype","v13":"mac_header_length","v14":"current_frame_control","v33":"qos_control"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":84,"meaning":"Context status flags; bit 0x2000 selects the pending Wi-Fi RX-frame path."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Context pointer to an RX buffer wrapper; its +8 field contains the frame-buffer pointer."},{"offset":0,"meaning":"RX 802.11 frame-control field."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"RX frame receiver/destination address; the low bit of its first octet identifies a group address."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"RX frame Address 3 field, copied into RX metadata when ToDS is set."},{"offset":22,"meaning":"RX frame sequence-control field, containing sequence and fragment numbers."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"RX frame Address 4 when both DS bits are set; otherwise the QoS-control field for QoS data frames."},{"offset":30,"meaning":"RX frame QoS-control field for QoS data frames with both DS bits set."}]}
